newsitem.title: USA: Scotts sees small net loss in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Scotts sees small net loss in Q4.

text.p: Scotts Co said Wednesday it expects to post a "small" net loss in the fourth quarter, bringing its full-year results in line with its targeted $1.30 to $1.35 per share net income.
The company said it expects sales in the fourth quarter to be between $135 million and $140 million.

Chairman, President and chief Executive Charles Berger said in a statement that more than 70 percent of Scotts' sales come in the second and third quarters, during the peak lawn care and gardening season.
During the fourth quarter, Scotts begins preparations for fiscal 1998's lawn care and gardening season. Sales are historically lower in the fourth quarter.
